title: Road Accident Deaths in Type of Vehicle during 2000
pdf_title: Road Accident Deaths in Type of Vehicle during 2000
notes: 1.3.8 TRAFFIC ACCIDENTS BY TIME OF OCCURRENCE:
1.3.8.1 It is interesting to note that comparatively more ‘Traffic Accidents’ were reported in the 2” quarter
(26.0%) of the year. The month-wise break-up of the accidents for each State/UT/City (Table-12) reveals that
majority of such accidents were reported during May (9.0%) and April (8.7%).
1.3.8.2 Month-wise distribution of ‘Road Accidents’ reported more accidents during April & May.
Maximum ‘Rail-Road Accidents’ occurred in the month of March & October. The maximum number of
‘Other Railway Accidents’ were reported during the month of September and October.
1.3.8.3 Tamil Nadu, which shared the maximum (15.9%) of Road Accident in the country also reported the
maximum number of Road Accidents during each month of the year. Delhi UT among UTs reported the
maximum number of ‘Road Accidents’ to the tune of 3.3% at national level, while Delhi city shared 17.2 per
cent of such accidents among 23 mega cities.
1.3.8.4 Andhra Pradesh reported 42.7 per cent of Rail-Road accidents in the country. December month
witnessed the least number of these accidents (70) compared to March which witnessed almost double (138)
